rules.title: Resources must carry accountability labels
rules.summary: Every resource must declare an owner and environment.
rules.description: Without an owner label, change control cannot route approvals and audit evidence cannot be attributed to an accountable party.
rules.remediation: Set tags.owner and tags.Environment on all resources.

checks.condition: tags.owner is set AND tags.Environment is set

rules.title: Backup and retention must be configured
rules.summary: Stateful resources must define a retention window of at least 7 days.
rules.description: Retention below a week leaves no recovery point for a slow-burning integrity incident, which typically surfaces after several days.
rules.remediation: Set backup retention to 7 days or more.
